author: Arthur Phillip
description: "The Voyage of Governor Phillip to Botany Bay" by Arthur Phillip is a historical account written in the late 18th century.
longDescription: The narrative details the maritime journey and subsequent establishment of the British penal colony in Australia, focusing on the experiences of Governor Phillip and his crew, as well as the interactions with Indigenous peoples.

authorInfo.bio:
Arthur Phillip (1738–1814) wrote The Voyage of Governor Phillip to Botany Bay
With an Account of the Establishment of the Colonies of Port Jackson and Norfolk Island (1789). Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
